verdict.rationale: Gecko documents an official MCP server. Once it is connected to an AI tool, that tool can list repositories and scans, pull vulnerability evidence, triage findings and file tickets, so the product can be driven in natural language. That control runs through a third-party AI client rather than a native natural-language interface, and the documented MCP operations do not explicitly include triggering scans or changing settings. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, documented natural-language control over scan triggering and configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP-driven workflow.
